answer: Admit agents like a cedar grove on a trellis: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; the winning bid locks as a deposit, half burned on cheating. With bids public, a farmer wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times - 50 credits a bid means 50,000 credits sunk before earning a cent. Bought accounts carry the deposit, so resale costs the same. One honest agent pays one bid, so honest entry stays cheap while flooding stays ruinous.
